dog.description_text: Meet Vanna! Vanna is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FVanna%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQqwNSAxavamTpv2lkR4%2DAqFEgUDwq0bp%5FGixRzp3A7OYULW2w Her foster says "She loves when I help her groom her face and ears. She loves to play even if it’s just from her bed, and would do anything for a churu. Vanna is extremely sweet and polite, she responds really well to being pet. She is also very smart and has shown the ability to learn tricks even through her shyness." She is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
